name: None
description: No restriction.

name: Do not get hit
description: Defeat the boss without taking a hit.

name: Apply status
description: Apply a status effect to the boss at least once.

name: Take riposte
description: Land at least one riposte on the boss.

name: Dodge an attack with duck / jump
description: At least once, avoid a boss attack by crouching under it or jumping over it.

name: Stand and complete 3 full gestures without getting hit
description: At least once, stand still and finish 3 gestures in a row without being hit.

name: Gesture after every flask
description: Finish a gesture after each flask you drink.

name: R1 only
description: The only attack input allowed is R1.

name: R2 only
description: The only attack input allowed is R2.

name: Charged R2 only
description: Every attack must be a fully charged R2.

name: L1 only (can swap hands)
description: The only attack input allowed is L1. You may swap your hands' gear so the one you want is on L1.

name: L2 spam
description: Kill the boss using only the skill (L2).

name: Jump attacks only
description: Every attack must be a jump attack.

name: Rolling / crouch attacks only
description: Every attack must come out of a roll or a crouch.

name: Parry only
description: Every attack must be a parry. No other attack input is allowed.

name: No ripostes
description: Never riposte the boss, even when its stance breaks.

name: No lock-on
description: Never lock on to the boss.

name: No healing flasks
description: Do not drink Flasks of Crimson Tears. Healing items, healing spells and blocking are allowed.

name: No armor
description: Fight with no armor on. The rolled armor set stays on the card; ignore it.

name: No talismans
description: Fight with no talismans on. The rolled talismans stay on the card; ignore them.

name: No rolling
description: Never roll. Backsteps and jumps are allowed.

name: Heavy rolling
description: Keep your equip load at 70% or more but under 100%, so every roll is a heavy roll.

name: Overloaded
description: Keep your equip load at 100% or more, so you can only walk slowly.

name: Deflecting Hardtear
description: Mix the Deflecting Hardtear into your Flask of Wondrous Physick and drink it during the fight.

name: Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear
description: Mix the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear into your Flask of Wondrous Physick and drink it during the fight.

name: Bloodsucking Cracked Tear
description: Mix the Bloodsucking Cracked Tear into your Flask of Wondrous Physick and drink it during the fight.

name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
description: Mix the Stonebarb Cracked Tear into your Flask of Wondrous Physick and drink it during the fight.

name: Ruptured Crystal Tear
description: Mix the Ruptured Crystal Tear into your Flask of Wondrous Physick and drink it during the fight.
